# 2 Kings Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 227r–228r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_006_page_001.jpg, 2KI_006_page_002.jpg, 2KI_006_page_003.jpg

---

**6:1** And-said the-sons of-the-prophets [beney ha-nevi'im] to Elisha: Behold, please, the-place which we [are] dwelling [yoshevim] there before-you [is] too-narrow [tsar] for-us.

**6:2** Let-us-go, please, to the-Yarden and-take from-there each-one a-beam [qorah], and-let-us-make for-us there a-place to-dwell there. And-he-said: Go.

**6:3** And-said the-one: Be-willing, please [ho'el na], and-go with your-servants. And-he-said: I will-go.

**6:4** And-he-went with-them, and-they-came to the-Yarden and-cut-down [vayigzeru] the-trees [ha-etsim].

**6:5** And-it-was the-one [was] felling [mappil] the-beam [ha-qorah], and-the-iron [ha-barzel] fell into the-water. And-he-cried-out and-said: Alas [ahah], my-master [adoni]! And-it was-borrowed [sha'ul]!

**6:6** And-said the-man of-God: Where did-it-fall [anah nafal]? And-he-showed-him the-place. And-he-cut [vayiqtsov] a-stick [ets] and-threw [it] there and-made-float [vayatsef] the-iron.

**6:7** And-he-said: Lift [harem] for-yourself. And-he-stretched-out his-hand and-took-it.

**6:8** And-the-king of-Aram was warring [nilcham] against-Yisra'el, and-he-counseled [vayivva'ats] with his-servants, saying: At-such and-such a-place [el maqom peloni almoni] [shall be] my-encampment [tachanoti].

**6:9** And-sent the-man of-God to the-king of-Yisra'el, saying: Guard [hishamer] from-passing [me'avor] this place, for there Aram [is] coming-down [nechitim].

**6:10** And-sent the-king of-Yisra'el to the-place which the-man of-God told-him and-warned-him [vehizhiro], and-he-guarded-himself there, not once and-not twice.

**6:11** And-was-stormy [vayissa'er] the-heart [lev] of-the-king of-Aram over this thing, and-he-called to-his-servants and-said to-them: Will-you-not tell [ha-lo taggidu] me who of-ours [is for] the-king of-Yisra'el?

**6:12** And-said one of-his-servants: No [lo], my-lord the-king, for Elisha the-prophet who [is] in-Yisra'el tells the-king of-Yisra'el the-words [ha-devarim] which you speak in-your-bedroom [ba-chadar mishkavekha].

**6:13** And-he-said: Go and-see where he [is], and-I-will-send and-take-him. And-it-was-told to-him, saying: Behold, in-Dotan.

**6:14** And-he-sent there horses and-chariots and-a-heavy army [chayil kaved], and-they-came by-night [laylah] and-surrounded [vayaqqifu] the-city.

**6:15** And-arose-early [vayashkem] the-servant of-the-man of-God to-rise and-went-out, and-behold, an-army [chayil] surrounding the-city, and-horses and-chariots. And-said his-servant to-him: Alas [ahah], my-master! How shall-we-do?

**6:16** And-he-said: Do-not fear [al tira], for more [rabbim] [are] those-who [are] with-us than-those-who [are] with-them.

**6:17** And-prayed Elisha and-said: YHWH, open [peqach], please, his-eyes and-let-him-see [veyir'eh]. And-opened YHWH the-eyes of-the-servant and-he-saw, and-behold, the-mountain [was] full of-horses and-chariots of-fire [esh] surrounding Elisha.

**6:18** And-they-came-down to-him, and-prayed Elisha to YHWH and-said: Strike [hakh], please, this nation [ha-goy ha-zeh] with-blindness [ba-sanverim]. And-he-struck-them with-blindness, according-to-the-word of-Elisha.

**6:19** And-said Elisha to-them: This [is] not the-way [ha-derekh] and-this [is] not the-city. Walk [lekhu] after-me and-I-will-lead-you [ve'olekhah] to the-man whom you-seek. And-he-led-them to-Shomron.

**6:20** And-it-was when-they-came to-Shomron, and-said Elisha: YHWH, open the-eyes of-these [eleh] and-let-them-see. And-opened YHWH their-eyes and-they-saw, and-behold, [they were] in-the-midst of-Shomron.

**6:21** And-said the-king of-Yisra'el to Elisha when-he-saw-them: Shall-I-strike [ha-akkeh], shall-I-strike, my-father [avi]?

**6:22** And-he-said: You-shall-not strike. Would-you strike those-whom you-captured [shavita] with-your-sword and-with-your-bow? Set [sim] bread and-water before-them and-let-them-eat and-drink and-go to their-master.

**6:23** And-he-prepared [vayikreh] for-them a-great feast [kerah gedolah], and-they-ate and-drank, and-he-sent-them-away and-they-went to their-master. And-not-again did-bands [gedudey] of-Aram come into-the-land of-Yisra'el.

**6:24** And-it-was after-this, and-gathered Ben-Hadad king of-Aram all his-camp [machaneihu] and-went-up and-besieged [vayatsar] Shomron.

**6:25** And-there-was a-great famine [ra'av gadol] in-Shomron, and-behold, [they were] besieging it until a-donkey's head [rosh chamor] was [sold] for-eighty silver-pieces, and-a-quarter of-a-qav [rova' ha-qav] of-dove's-dung [chireyyonim] for-five silver-pieces.

**6:26** And-was the-king of-Yisra'el passing over the-wall, and-a-woman cried-out to-him, saying: Save [hoshi'ah], my-lord the-king!

**6:27** And-he-said: If-YHWH does-not-save-you [al yoshia'ekh], from-where [me-ayin] shall-I-save-you? From the-threshing-floor [ha-goren] or from the-winepress [ha-yaqev]?

**6:28** And-said to-her the-king: What [is] to-you [mah-lakh]? And-she-said: This woman said to-me: Give your-son and-we-will-eat-him today, and-my-son we-will-eat tomorrow.

**6:29** And-we-boiled [vannevasshel] my-son and-ate-him. And-I-said to-her on-the-next day [ba-yom ha-acher]: Give your-son and-we-will-eat-him. And-she-hid [vatachbi] her-son.

**6:30** And-it-was when-the-king heard the-words of-the-woman, and-he-tore his-garments — and-he [was] passing on the-wall — and-the-people saw, and-behold, sackcloth [saq] on his-flesh from-within [mibayit].

**6:31** And-he-said: Thus may-God do to-me and-thus may-he-add [ko ya'aseh li elohim ve-ko yosif], if the-head of-Elisha son of-Shafat stands [ya'amod] upon-him today!

**6:32** And-Elisha was-sitting [yoshev] in-his-house and-the-elders [ha-zeqenim] were-sitting with-him. And-he-sent a-man from-before-him. Before [be-terem] the-messenger came to-him, and-he said to the-elders: Do-you-see how this son of-a-murderer [ben ha-meratstsyeach] has-sent to-take-off [lehasir] my-head? See [re'u], when-the-messenger comes, shut [sigru] the-door and-hold-the-door-fast [ulechattsem] against-him. Is-not the-sound of-his-master's feet [qol ragley adonav] behind-him?

**6:33** He [was] still speaking [medabber] with-them, and-behold, the-messenger came-down to-him, and-he-said: Behold, this evil [ha-ra'ah] [is] from YHWH. Why should-I-wait [ayachel] for-YHWH any-longer ['od]?

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.5 — "it was borrowed":** The detail that the axe head was *sha'ul* (borrowed) amplifies the distress. Losing a borrowed iron tool was economically devastating — iron was expensive and the prophetic community was poor.

**v.17 — horses and chariots of fire:** The heavenly army mirrors the earthly one (v.14-15). The fire-chariots connect to Elijah's ascent (2:11). What the servant cannot naturally see, YHWH opens his eyes to perceive — the invisible realm is more real than the visible threat.

**v.25 — dove's dung:** Hebrew *chireyyonim* — likely a euphemism for a type of edible seed pod (star of Bethlehem bulbs), though the Masoretic text reads literally "dove's dung." The famine prices indicate total economic collapse.

**v.32 — "son of a murderer":** Elisha calls the king *ben ha-meratstsyeach*, literally "son of the murderer." This likely refers to Ahab (or Jezebel) and their murderous acts (Naboth's vineyard). Elisha knows the king's intent before the messenger arrives — prophetic foresight.

**v.33 — "this evil is from YHWH":** The speaker's identity is debated — the Hebrew could indicate the messenger speaking the king's words, or the king himself arriving behind the messenger. The theological crisis: if YHWH has caused this evil, why wait for deliverance from YHWH?

*— EMET*
